name: product
description: Product delivery discipline — slice any functional spec into thin vertical iterations (vertical-slice: 17 splitting techniques + a method to choose and combine them per feature, technical constraint and execution mode), ship each one without blocking (delivery: feature flags sized to the project, additive no-BC-break change, expand/contract, and the cleanup that closes the loop once it's in prod), and write each story so a PO and a developer both read it fast (story-writing: problem, functional rules, one criterion per rule, technical annex).
